about: The Staff Building Steps at Night, one change: written by hand on 11 Oct 2026 after reading art_14p.json. Both versions kept the teachers' house lit on both floors, as its chosen day picture has it. By 5.7a a room is lit at Night only when someone is up in it: Yaga is up upstairs on every Night and the lounge on the ground floor is empty. One named change on version A (given at full size) by the tool's own keep-everything prompt with the change as its own sentence, as in 8b and 15s.

Second time the editor has changed more than the one thing asked (15s widened a door; here a pavilion was lit, or a curtain taken). A repaint of the same camera is a source of pixels: the one region that had to change is placed by tool, and nothing else is taken from it.

sentences.change: Change one thing only: in the two-storey house on the right, the windows of the ground floor are dark, with no light behind them, like the other dark windows in the picture. The upstairs windows of that house stay lit exactly as they are. Change nothing else in the picture: it stays night, with the same moon.

read_2026_10_11.staff_yard_night2_b: The ground floor is dark and nothing else is lit, but the red curtain is gone from the house's door.

staff_yard_night_lounge.what: CHOSEN (the owner had chosen night A with this change owed). The night picture of 14p's version A, with ONLY the ground-floor strip of the teachers' house taken from version A of this repaint: both ground-floor windows dark, the curtain kept, no light under it. Every other pixel is the chosen night's own: the pavilion, the hall and the offices are dark, the upstairs windows lit, the same moon.
staff_yard_night_lounge.how: tools/art/staged/early/lounge_dark_14q.py (our own tool): a rectangle over the house's ground floor, softened by 3 px. Changed pixels lie within (2230, 780)-(2752, 976) of 2752 x 1536.
